kind: Retrospective audit of original saved forecasts, NOT an untouched holdout
selection: All available original main-market numeric OVER/UNDER probabilities with valid pregame saved/forecast timestamps, exact matching line and fixture older than four hours. Select without grade, outcome, side or confidence filtering. Earliest saved decision per market/fixture/player.
benchmark: Constant 0.5 conditional probability only; no two-sided market prices available in this source, so no no-vig book or ROI claim.
sourceCoverage: Report source coverage; missing finals/player statistics remain unresolved, never zero.
